race.comment: TAHNEE TERRITORY (5) has been facing tougher company than this recently, and she is not too badly placed at this easier level with just 58kg to carry. She seems to prefer the cut in the ground, and from a good draw on a track where she has yet to taste defeat, she has winning claims. KAYLA KRUZEN (3) is chasing a hat-trick after going back-to-back here in both of her runs since resuming from a spell. A wide gate makes it tough, but she can still get the job done. CHAMPAGNE JENNI (2) had to work too hard from a wide gate at Morphettville 6 days ago, and if this race has not come too soon for her, then she can make amends in an easier assignment. Each way. HEART OF THE MED (1) had no luck after a wide run from a tough gate last time out. She tries a longer trip for the first time, and is worth another chance. TRANTORO (4) loves it here, and was back in winning form on this track nearly 3 weeks ago. Stick with her.
